vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is patching a seam with a scrap of cloth, knot after careful knot. Better close to the fire today.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Owen, Ciro, the woman in her 60s, the woman in her 50s and Daniyar met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Owen, Ciro, the woman in her 60s, the woman in her 50s, Daniyar are hurt.
🛡️ Priya, Ciro, Greta and Elif met them at the door — 4 put down. Priya, Ciro, Greta, Elif are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ciro, Greta, Elif and Brian met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Ciro, Greta, Elif, Brian are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Priya, Brian and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down. Priya, Brian, Daniyar are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Owen was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Greta showed Elif the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Ella has been turning the European Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Ella is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
